title: sales
text:
sales

maria_sales: @marco_cto quick check — what exact assurance pack do you need for the POC? SOC 2 + pen-test attestation, or also ISO extracts?
marco_cto: SOC2 report + signed pen-test attestation (from the vendor performing the scan). Also a basic network diagram and a secure upload method for the artifacts.
ajay_se: We can provide a SOC 2 Type II summary and a vendor-signed pen-test attestation letter. Note: procurement usually won't accept raw vuln detail, they want an attestation.
olivia_security: FYI our latest pen-test was run by HalcyonSec (2025). We can produce an attestation letter from them. Need to confirm if they require scope-level details or full findings.
marco_cto: Attestation is fine. Also need confirmation that no customer data will be leaked in the report.
rebecca_legal: We'll redact any customer-specific data. I can draft the vendor attestation and a short DPIA note. Timeline?
maria_sales: They want evidence by EOW to keep the POC schedule. Is that realistic?
ben_infra: For artifact transfer I recommend presigned S3 links (48h) or a scoped SFTP drop. For staging creds we can provide a read-only, short-lived token.
ajay_se: I'll prepare a minimal network diagram + SOC2 summary. Example config snippet I'll include: 
```
VPC peering -> NAT -> app nodes (private) -> ELB
Staging IP range: 3.120.10.0/24
```
olivia_security: Action items: legal drafts attestation, ops creates presigned S3, SE prepares SOC2 summary + diagram. Assigning tasks.
rebecca_legal: Drafting attestation now. Does anyone have the HalcyonSec engagement id?
olivia_security: Engagement id HS-2025-0812 — I'll DM the report to @rebecca_legal.
maria_sales: Marco — if we deliver attestation + SOC2 summary + diagram + presigned upload by Thu noon, will procurement accept that?
marco_cto: Yes. One more ask: procurement wants to run an external scan against staging. Is that allowed?
ben_infra: External scans allowed against staging IPs only, scheduled with 24h notice, and limited windows off-peak. We'll require a signed scan scope.
ajay_se: We also have a pen-test letter template that we require their vendor to sign which names Redwood and the allowed scope — can send that.
marco_cto: Please send the template.
maria_sales: Sending the template now. Heads-up: procurement may flag a one-off compliance handling fee if we provide bespoke artifacts — how do we handle pricing?
rebecca_legal: Standard policy: $2k compliance handling fee for ad-hoc evidence requests outside the normal SOW. We can waive if the customer commits to a reserved/dedicated contract.
maria_sales: Noted — I'll flag the potential fee in the quote but try to avoid it. :crossed_fingers: 
olivia_security: Quick Q — do we need to mask IP ranges in the SOC2 summary? We usually provide high-level architecture only.
rebecca_legal: High-level is fine. We'll redact specifics and add language in the attestation about redaction.
marco_cto: Thanks team. Timeline confirmed — we'll schedule the external scan windows after you send the presigned link.
audit-bot: Audit artifact uploaded to /compliance/poc-acme-4123456789/ (internal) :white_check_mark:
maria_sales: Great — closing the loop. I'll confirm when procurement signs off.
